en.goBackendSubtitle: Full autonomy, single binary for Windows, macOS and Linux
en.localServerDesc: In the /go-backend/ folder, complete source code in pure Go is provided. It compiles into a single executable without requiring PostgreSQL, SQLite, or Docker!
en.serverUrlNote: Server runs on http://localhost:8080 (or port from PORT variable).
en.crossBuildTitle: Build standalone binary for any OS:
en.dbJsonFileDesc: Contains all your current locations, shelves, boxes and items
en.archSection1Desc: The database is stored in a local db.json file in the application folder. Read/writes are protected by a thread-safe sync.RWMutex. Photos are saved in the relative ./uploads/ folder; only relative paths are stored in the database.
en.archSection2Desc:
1. Location (Home, Garage, Cottage)
2. Rack / Furniture (Wardrobe, Workbench)
3. Shelf (Shelf 1, Shelf 2 — counting from bottom)
4. Box / Container (Box 1, Organizer A)
en.archSection3Desc: Code format: [Location]-[Furniture]-[Shelf]-[Box] (e.g., h-w1-s3-b1). If item is directly on the shelf: h-w1-s3.
en.archSection4Desc: When calling DELETE /api/locations/:id, items inside or under its sublocations are verified. If items exist, deletion is safely prevented.
en.filesSectionDesc: Go server source code is divided into clean modules according to specifications:
en.clickCategoryHint: Click on any category in the tree on the left to filter the items stored there.
en.clickLocationHint: Click on any shelf or box in the tree on the left to filter the items stored there.
en.deployFolderTitle: Deploying to a New Folder or Another PC
en.deployFolderDesc: To run in a new folder, you must copy BOTH the executable (inventory.exe) AND the frontend folder (web/ from go-backend/web).
